title: Two-quantifier efficient verification
statement: A language $L$ belongs to the class defined by an efficient two-witness verifier if there are a verifier $N$ and natural numbers $a_1,k_1,a_2,k_2$ such that $N$ is efficient according to $E$. For every input $x$, membership in $L$ is equivalent to the existence of a string $u$ of length $a_1+k_1|x|$ such that, for every string $v$ of length $a_2+k_2|x|$, the verifier outputs true on $(x,u,v)$.
hypotheses_covered: A verifier N and natural numbers a₁,k₁,a₂,k₂ exist
